violated_contract: An unambiguous continuation command that directly follows a non-empty assistant answer must resume that answer. Treating a bare Continue as an unrelated prompt lets the model restart, summarize, or repeat the original long-form request.
canonical_prevention: Recognize only short, explicit continuation commands after an assistant turn, preserve the user's text, and add a server-owned resume contract before the provider call. Regress both the recognition boundary and the provider payload through the real agent stream.
